picks.title: Creating an AI Short Film (Full Workflow) | Runway
picks.excerpt: Runway walks through an end-to-end short-film build inside its toolset, from reference and shot planning to generation, extension and assembly. A rare start-to-finish look at how a generative short is actually structured rather than a feature teaser.
picks.rationale: Highest actionability in the pool — a full, reproducible short-film pipeline from the vendor itself, not a feature teaser.

picks.title: ILM and Pixar Named in Disney's AI Push as Cost Cuts Continue
picks.excerpt: An SEC filing shows Disney funding machine learning at Disney Research Studios and Imagineering, with ILM and Pixar named, and promising a creative process that stays 'human-centered.' The pledge lands after job reductions at Pixar and the creation of an internal AI oversight body.
picks.rationale: Disclosed in an SEC filing, so it is the hardest evidence yet of where AI sits inside ILM and Pixar's actual production org.

picks.title: Promise AI Developing Horror Feature 'Touch Grass'; Dave Clark Directing
picks.excerpt: AI studio Promise is developing an original horror feature with 'Backrooms' filmmaker Dave Clark directing, produced with Bloody Disgusting. It is another test of whether a generative-first pipeline can carry a full narrative feature rather than a short.
picks.rationale: Same-day news that moves the generative-first pipeline from short-form proof to a financed narrative feature with a genre partner attached.

picks.title: AI Studio Asteria Strikes Strategic Partnership With Virtual Production Studio ZeroSpace
picks.excerpt: Generative studio Asteria is tying its 'clean' model pipeline to ZeroSpace's virtual production stage, volumetric capture and mocap facilities. The deal points at a hybrid workflow where live capture and generative shots are built in the same production.
picks.rationale: A licensed-model studio bolting onto a real volumetric/mocap stage is the concrete shape of the hybrid capture-plus-generation workflow.

picks.title: HBO Max Dips Toe Into Vertical Video With 'HBO Max Shorts' and New AI-Driven Features
picks.excerpt: HBO Max is launching a vertical 'Shorts' feed alongside AI-driven conversational search and discovery features. A streamer reformatting premium catalogue for vertical playback changes the framing and cutdown work asked of editors and promo teams.
picks.rationale: A premium streamer adding a vertical feed plus AI discovery changes the reframing and cutdown briefs editors and promo teams get next.
